voice.text: Welcome to FORK, your own fork of Singapore.
Where Singapore's streets and buildings take shape in Minecraft.
Where you can explore, build, and make a neighbourhood your own.
Where a medic, an engineer and a courier each have a part to play.
And where a real-world tradeoff becomes a scenario you can step into.
Keep the clinic running. Restore the workshop. Decide where limited power should go.
Watch your choices play out through six rounds.
And where what if is something you can try.
Rewind to the same starting point. Make another choice.
Watch a different future take shape.
Then compare what changed, and what each choice made possible.
A place to explore. To experiment. To make your own.
FORK. Your own fork of Singapore. Have fun.
